title: Runbook: publish-release.mjs does not run the same gates as release.yml (omits release-provenance and check-breaking-bump --pair)
description: Raised while running the 0.13.0 release (QCLI-433, DEC-169). docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md, section "Publishing locally when CI cannot", says scripts/publish-release.mjs performs the same fail-closed, receipt-gated publish as release.yml. Read from the script, that is false: publish-release.mjs runs version parity (requireVersionParity), the opum-cli-e2e receipt gate (requireQualification, binding version/commit/releaseRunId and the seven tarball sha256), the native-execution receipt (validateReceipt), candidate-bundle integrity, and the launcher substitution check -- but it imports and runs neither release-provenance.mjs (--pre/--post) nor check-breaking-bump.mjs --pair, both of which release.yml runs. A reader taking the local route unknowingly drops two CI gates. Found at quest-cli main 5996e24a during the 0.13.0 publish (the two gates were run by hand there: release-provenance --pre with GITHUB_REF=refs/tags/v0.13.0, and check-breaking-bump --pair, both exit 0). Do not fix inside the release.

acceptanceCriteria.text: docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md no longer asserts that scripts/publish-release.mjs runs the same gates as release.yml; it names the gate set each route runs.

The runbook states that release-provenance (--pre/--post) and check-breaking-bump --pair run only in release.yml, and that the local route must run them by hand -- including the release-provenance --pre form, which needs GITHUB_REF=refs/tags/v<version>.
A reader following the local route can enumerate every gate release.yml would have run and where each one is covered.

finalSummary:
Corrected docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md so it no longer claims scripts/publish-release.mjs runs the same gates as release.yml. The old "performs the same fail-closed, receipt-gated publish" wording in the numbered release steps, and the "gated the same way CI is" wording in "Publishing locally when CI cannot", are both replaced. A new subsection, "The gate set each route runs", enumerates every gate release.yml runs in workflow order and where the local route covers each one, states that release-provenance.mjs (--pre and --post) and check-breaking-bump.mjs --pair run ONLY in release.yml and must be run by hand on the local route, and gives the exact hand-run commands -- including release-provenance --pre, which needs GITHUB_REF=refs/tags/v<version>.

Verified against the sources, not the prose: scripts/publish-release.mjs imports neither scripts/qualification/release-provenance.mjs nor scripts/check-breaking-bump.mjs (its imports are bundle-integrity, e2e-receipt, native-execution-receipt, registry-visibility and version-parity), while .github/workflows/release.yml runs both; the covered rows are the publish-release.mjs imports and the wrapper/registry reads it performs. lore sync appended two log.md entries; lore check reports 65 files, 0 errors, 4 pre-existing agent-profile-capacity warnings. No script changed.

Review round 1 (review-assignment, attempt 1, head 5da78890) returned changes-requested with two minor findings, both verified against the sources and corrected in the runbook: the 'Fetch the native-execution receipt' row overstated the operator's step (the local script downloads and proves the quest-candidate-bundle itself from --qualification-run, and only the native-execution receipt is operator-supplied), and the npm OIDC floor row named a Node floor the step never asserts (Node is pinned by setup-node, not checked).
